stories.title: 1-seed Zverev reaches 3rd major final of 2026 at US Open
stories.summary: Alexander Zverev will play for his second Grand Slam title this year after beating Karen Khachanov 6-3, 7-6 (7), 7-6 (6) on Friday in the US Open semifinals.

stories.title: Sources: Bears, Swift agree to $33.75M extension
stories.summary: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a 3-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5M guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Falcons' Tagovailoa out, Rush to start vs. Steelers
stories.summary: The Falcons will start backup Cooper Rush at quarterback in Sunday's opener against the Steelers after ruling starter Tua Tagovailoa out with an oblique injury.

stories.title: Townsend, Siniakova win US Open doubles, complete career GS as pair
stories.summary: Taylor Townsend and Katerina Siniakova completed their career Grand Slam as a team by defeating the wild-card pair of Ashlyn Krueger and Robin Montgomery for their first US Open doubles title together.

stories.title: Twins' Buxton to have hip surgery, done for season
stories.summary: Twins outfielder Byron Buxton, who has been on the injured list since Aug. 30, will undergo surgery on his right hip and miss the remainder of the season.
